name: SIGMA - SSH Session With Many Authentication Attempts
description:
Detects SSH connections in Zeek ssh.log where the server saw five or more
authentication attempts within a single connection - the pattern of password guessing
tools that reuse one TCP connection up to the server's MaxAuthTries limit. Zeek infers
attempts from the encrypted packet-size heuristics, so the count is an estimate. Tools
that open a new connection per password evade this single-event rule; the aggregation
(correlation) version is listed as future work.
